svg.title: How to measure nail width
svg.desc: Three photographic examples: wrap a narrow paper strip across the widest part of a natural nail, mark both sidewalls, then flatten the strip and measure the marked distance with a millimeter ruler.

g.text: Measure nail width in millimeters, from sidewall to sidewall.
Lay a narrow paper strip across
the widest part of your nail.
Let it follow the nail’s curve.
Keep the strip in the same place.
Flatten the strip against a ruler.
Measure both hands, then compare with the Ginny Nana size chart.
